fr.sorbonne_u.components.hem2025e3.equipments.generator

Class GeneratorCyPhy

  • java.lang.Object
    • fr.sorbonne_u.components.AbstractComponent
      • fr.sorbonne_u.components.cyphy.AbstractCyPhyComponent
        • fr.sorbonne_u.components.hem2025e3.equipments.generator.GeneratorCyPhy
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    fr.sorbonne_u.components.ComponentI, fr.sorbonne_u.components.cyphy.interfaces.CyPhyComponentI, GeneratorImplementationI

    public class GeneratorCyPhy
extends fr.sorbonne_u.components.cyphy.AbstractCyPhyComponent
implements GeneratorImplementationI
    The class GeneratorCyPhy implements an electric generator component for the Household Energy Management project.

    Description

    Implementation Invariants

     invariant       true        // no more invariant

    Invariants

     invariant       STANDARD_INBOUND_PORT_URI != null && !STANDARD_INBOUND_PORT_URI.isEmpty()
 invariant       OUTPUT_AC_TENSION != null && (OUTPUT_AC_TENSION.equals(new Measure<Double>(110.0, TENSION_UNIT)) || OUTPUT_AC_TENSION.equals(new Measure<Double>(220.0, TENSION_UNIT)))
 invariant       MIN_FUEL_CONSUMPTION != null && MIN_FUEL_CONSUMPTION.getData() > 0.0 && MIN_FUEL_CONSUMPTION.getMeasurementUnit().equals(CONSUMPTION_UNIT)
 invariant       MAX_FUEL_CONSUMPTION != null && MAX_FUEL_CONSUMPTION.getData() > 0.0 && MAX_FUEL_CONSUMPTION.getMeasurementUnit().equals(CONSUMPTION_UNIT)
 invariant       MIN_FUEL_CONSUMPTION.getData() <= MAX_FUEL_CONSUMPTION.getData()
 invariant       TANK_CAPACITY != null && TANK_CAPACITY.getData() > 0.0 && TANK_CAPACITY.getMeasurementUnit().equals(CAPACITY_UNIT)
 invariant       MAX_POWER != null && MAX_POWER.getData() > 0.0 && MAX_POWER.getMeasurementUnit().equals(POWER_UNIT)
